risk_if_not_implemented: Without Risk Tolerance, risks may remain unidentified, unowned or unmanaged, leaving decision-makers without a defensible basis for prioritization and treatment. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Risk Management Program
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of strategic, operational and tactical risk management controls that are aligned with:
(1) The organization's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM); and
(2) Industry-recognized cybersecurity risk management practices.
compensating_control_1.justification: Risk Management Program (RSK-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Risk Tolerance (RSK-05.1) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the design, implementation, and monitoring of security, compliance and resilience governance controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP) (GOV-02) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Risk Tolerance (RSK-05.1) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
